zh-CN: 此文章用于声明必达通知的去向。
从2026.9.1开始，我们将全面启用官网文章板块来进行通知，原先的binder-notice-board仓库将被归档并导至此处。
文章板块兼具宣传、通知两大职责，会在未来发布通知、产品发布、各类总结等内容。
同时，文章板块允许开发者发表自己的内容，只需在官网仓库提出PR即可。
请各位开发者尽快适应新模式，并发表你的想法。
en-US: This article declares the destination of Binder notices.
Starting from 2026.9.1, we will fully enable the website article section for notifications, archiving the binder-notice-board repository and migrating it here.
The article section combines promotional and notification responsibilities, and will publish notifications, product releases, and various summaries in the future.
At the same time, the article section allows developers to publish their own content, just submit a PR to the official website repository.
Please adapt to the new model as soon as possible and share your thoughts.
